title: SugarCRM Review (2026)
intro: Customer experience CRM (Sugar Sell) with Standard through Premier editions and Sugar Intelligence AI. This review covers verified 2026 pricing, core CRM capabilities, limitations, and who should buy — based on official first-party sources.
summary: SugarCRM scores reflect first-party research — not hands-on product testing.
verdict: SugarCRM (Sugar Sell) is a credible mid-market CX CRM with transparent Standard/Advanced/Premier pricing and Sugar Intelligence AI. Choose it when you want more CX depth than SMB CRMs without fully committing to Salesforce complexity. Not hands-on tested.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Mid-market CX CRM with more structure than SMB tools; lighter than Salesforce for many teams but not Pipedrive-simple.
Sugar Sell centers on sales pipeline and opportunity management.
Automation and sales process support deepen on Advanced/Premier.
Solid sales email/activity capabilities for mid-market CRM.
Reporting suitable for mid-market; Premier adds sophistication.
Strong mid-market customization relative to peer sell-side CRMs.
Partner/integration ecosystem solid though smaller than Salesforce.
Meaningful admin/config investment expected on Advanced/Premier.
Standard→Premier ladder supports SMB through mid-market/enterprise sell motions.
Published $59/$85/$135 annual ladder is clearer than many enterprise quotes.

bestFor: Mid-market sales orgs wanting CX CRM
cons: Entry price above many SMB tools
pricingSummary: No free plan. USD per user/mo annual: Sugar Sell Standard $59, Advanced $85, Premier $135.
limitations: Confirm live SugarCRM checkout; packaging can change.
whoShouldChoose: Choose SugarCRM when it matches your CRM buying criteria above.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Consider alternatives like salesforce, hubspot, dynamics-365 if fit is weak.
